key.rangesight.sculk: Toggle sculk sensor and shrieker range
key.rangesight.trial: Toggle trial spawner and vault range
rangesight.help.beacon: How far a beacon's effects reach: 20 to 50 blocks out (by pyramid levels), up to the sky.
rangesight.help.conduit: Where a conduit gives Conduit Power: 32 to 96 blocks (by its prismarine frame).
rangesight.help.spawner: The sphere you must be inside for a spawner to work, plus the box its mobs spawn in.
rangesight.help.raid: The 96-block area around a raid's center (single player and LAN host).
rangesight.help.sculk: How far sculk sensors (8), calibrated sensors (16) and shriekers (8) hear you, and a shrieker's 40-block Darkness.
rangesight.help.spawn_chunks: The chunks that stay loaded around world spawn (up to Minecraft 1.21.8).
rangesight.help.trial: How close you must be for a trial spawner (14) or a vault (4) to wake up.
rangesight.hint: Range Sight is ready: press %s to show every range, or the numpad keys for one type. Change keys and colors in Options > Controls or the Range Sight settings.
rangesight.broken_config: Range Sight: your settings file had a mistake, so the defaults are used. Your old file was kept as config/%s.
rangesight.settings.title: Range Sight settings
rangesight.settings.color.tip: Click to try the next color. Exact colors (#RRGGBB) can be typed into config/rangesight.json.
rangesight.settings.width.tip: How thick the outlines are (1 to 5).
rangesight.settings.distance.tip: How far around you Range Sight looks for beacons, spawners and so on. Lower is lighter on slow computers.
rangesight.settings.keys: Keys: numpad 0-7, numpad . opens this screen (change them in Options > Controls)
